sources.title: NOAA NCEI topographic/bathymetric DEM mosaic
sources.notes: F32 grid resampled to 513×513. Mosaic combines historical surveys and vertical datums; not current marine navigation or a tidal model. Land and seabed exaggeration are visual.

sources.title: City and County of San Francisco building footprints, via public ArcGIS mirror
sources.notes: 20,000-source-feature bounded sample. Simplified footprints and median height; historical city records, not current full Bay Area coverage. Source identifiers retained.

sources.title: Illustrative processes and animated agents
sources.notes: Wind, currents, solar cycle, wildlife, vessels, cars, flight paths, utility lines and vegetation sketches are designed illustrations, not observed live feeds or a calibrated simulation. Bridge and landmark meshes are stylized, geographically positioned illustrations.

sources.title: SF Public Works street centerlines (2022 mirror snapshot)
sources.notes: Partial sampled centerline network; public mirror, historical snapshot. Not current road traffic.

sources.title: SF municipal street-tree inventory (Esri sample mirror, last edited 2018)
sources.notes: 8000-point historical sample with mapped locations. Not all trees, not a current inventory, crown sizes stylized.
